choose.when: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users kwa WHERE kwa.id = r.assignee_id AND kwa.deleted_at = 0 AND kwa.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM requirement_comments kwc WHERE kwc.requirement_id = r.id AND kwc.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
choose.otherwise: AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(requirement_no, 17) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM requirements WHERE requirement_no LIKE CONCAT(#{datePrefix}, '%')
SELECT * FROM requirements WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE requirements SET deleted_at = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u1.real_name as creator_name, u2.real_name as assignee_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requirements WHERE parent_id = r.id AND deleted_at = 0) as child_count FROM requirements r LEFT JOIN users u1 ON r.creator_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON r.assignee_id = u2.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted_at = 0
